suggestions.quote: At eighty, the shout from age nine is as loud as this morning, and so is the morning she taught you to ride a cycle.
suggestions.fix: Stage this on the existing lamp room and kitchen sets, not a new one. Age you with a grey tuft and a stick on the same rig, and show time passing with calendar pages drifting past. The cycle is the only new prop; build it as a plain two-wheel side-on silhouette with mom's hand on the seat. Keep the nine-year-old as the same rig scaled down, with the shout as a bubble of four words or fewer.

suggestions.quote: Your room papered with every page you have read, and the crimson shout from age nine following you into the kitchen, talking over the tea she just brought
suggestions.fix: Make this the one wordless peak: 8 to 10 s, music dropping out, the pages stacking on the walls, a slow camera drift, and the crimson shout bubble sliding past with no narration. Reuse the single ruled-page sprite as an instanced layer, and slide the kitchen in as a second layer on the room set. Keep the shout as a bubble of four words or fewer, off the faces.

suggestions.quote: Mom brings tea; you take it, look up, and the pages settle on the desk.
suggestions.fix: Keep the tea, the hands and the pages in the left two-thirds for the last 15 s. Leave the right third empty for end screens, and put the final real-thing line on the desk image, not on a tag.
